selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of generalized painful fluid-filled skin lesions, yellow scleral discoloration, fever, and mucosal involvement following ciprofloxacin use, along with laboratory findings of elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin, supports Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic pustules and the presence of bullae and mucosal involvement

rejected.label: Severe cutaneous adverse reaction
rejected.why: Too broad a term, as the patient's symptoms are more specific to Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome
